verdict.rationale: Smooth runs browser-agent tasks autonomously on its own cloud infrastructure. You submit a task via the SDK or API, it executes without supervision (auto-CAPTCHA solving keeps execution uninterrupted), and you check results by polling or watch through a live URL. That covers one-off autonomous background execution, but nothing shows a recurring schedule or trigger for standing automations, and monitoring is described only as 'on demand'. Missing for 10: scheduled/recurring or event-triggered automations, persistent automation definitions, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: The Smooth API enables programmatic browser automation through REST endpoints. You can run AI-powered tasks
The API uses polling rather than webhooks or WebSockets
Bypass CAPTCHA challenges automatically, allowing for uninterrupted task execution.
When running a task, you will receive a `live_url`, which can be used to view the agent actions live.
